meaning: pile; to pile up; (measure word) a pile of

senses.en: pile; to pile up; (measure word) a pile of

examples.zh: 桌子上堆着很多书。
examples.en: Lots of books are piled on the table.

examples.zh: 地上有一堆垃圾，没人管。
examples.en: There is a pile of trash on the ground and nobody deals with it.

examples.zh: 我有一堆事要做，今天不能去了。
examples.en: I have a pile of things to do, so I can't go today.

examples.zh: 我在学校参加了足球俱乐部。
examples.en: I joined the soccer club at school.

examples.zh: 这个俱乐部每星期六都有活动。
examples.en: This club has an activity every Saturday.

examples.zh: 你想加入我们的读书俱乐部吗？
examples.en: Would you like to join our book club?

examples.zh: 小心，这条狗会咬人。
examples.en: Careful, this dog bites.

examples.zh: 狗咬了我的手，很疼。
examples.en: The dog bit my hand and it really hurts.

examples.zh: 苹果太硬，我咬不动。
examples.en: The apple is too hard; I can't bite through it.

meaning: polite; courteous; to stand on ceremony

senses.en: polite; courteous; to stand on ceremony

note: 别客气 = you're welcome / make yourself at home. 不客气 = you're welcome.

examples.zh: 你别这么客气，请坐。
examples.en: Don't be so formal; please sit down.

examples.zh: 你先吃，别客气！
examples.en: You eat first, don't stand on ceremony!

examples.zh: 他对谁都很客气。
examples.en: He is polite to everyone.

examples.zh: 学汉语，关键是多说。
examples.en: In learning Chinese, the key is to speak more.

examples.zh: 这是一个关键问题。
examples.en: This is a crucial question.

examples.zh: 关键时候，他帮了我一把。
examples.en: At a crucial moment, he gave me a hand.

meaning: to grab; to fight for; to snatch

senses.en: to grab; to fight for; to snatch

examples.zh: 别抢，每个人都有。
examples.en: Don't grab; everyone gets one.

examples.zh: 过年的时候，大家都在网上抢红包。
examples.en: At New Year everyone grabs red envelopes online.

examples.zh: 我想抢一张回家的票。
examples.en: I want to snag a ticket home.

examples.zh: 不幸的是，飞机晚点了。
examples.en: Unfortunately, the flight was delayed.

examples.zh: 听到你爸爸生病的不幸消息，我很难过。
examples.en: I was sad to hear the unfortunate news that your dad is ill.

examples.zh: 他在一次事故中不幸去世了。
examples.en: He sadly died in an accident.

meaning: to recover; to restore; to resume

senses.en: to recover; to restore; to resume

examples.zh: 手术后，他恢复得很快。
examples.en: After the surgery, he recovered quickly.

examples.zh: 网络什么时候能恢复？
examples.en: When will the network be back?

examples.zh: 请先休息，等身体恢复了再上班。
examples.en: Please rest first, and go back to work once you've recovered.

examples.zh: 我下午要见一位重要的客户。
examples.en: I'm meeting an important client this afternoon.

examples.zh: 这个客户对价格不满意。
examples.en: This client is not happy with the price.

examples.zh: 我们要给客户打电话。
examples.en: We need to call the client.

note: Stronger than 不能; a rule or an order.

examples.zh: 医院里不许抽烟。
examples.en: Smoking is not allowed in the hospital.

examples.zh: 妈妈不许我太晚睡。
examples.en: Mom doesn't let me go to bed too late.

examples.zh: 这里不许拍照。
examples.en: No photos here.

examples.zh: 这是我小时候最美好的记忆。
examples.en: This is my best memory from childhood.

examples.zh: 年纪大了，他的记忆不如以前了。
examples.en: With age, his memory is not what it was.

examples.zh: 我记忆中的家乡不是这样的。
examples.en: My hometown as I remember it was not like this.

note: More formal than 女人; used in reports and notices.

examples.zh: 这家公司有很多女性员工。
examples.en: This company has many female employees.

examples.zh: 这本杂志是给女性看的。
examples.en: This magazine is meant for women.

examples.zh: 男性和女性的体检项目不一样。
examples.en: Men and women have different checkup items.

examples.zh: 医生警告他不要再喝酒了。
examples.en: The doctor warned him not to drink any more.

examples.zh: 我收到了一个警告，说我开得太快。
examples.en: I got a warning saying I was driving too fast.

examples.zh: 这是最后一次警告，别再迟到了。
examples.en: This is the last warning; don't be late again.

examples.zh: 中国队得了冠军。
examples.en: The Chinese team won the championship.

examples.zh: 他是去年的游泳冠军。
examples.en: He was last year's swimming champion.

examples.zh: 你觉得谁会拿冠军？
examples.en: Who do you think will win?

examples.zh: 我想尝试一下新的方法。
examples.en: I want to try a new method.

examples.zh: 第一次尝试，我失败了。
examples.en: On my first attempt, I failed.

examples.zh: 你可以尝试用手机付钱。
examples.en: You can try paying by phone.

meaning: to play (a string or keyboard instrument); to pluck

senses.en: to play (a string or keyboard instrument); to pluck

note: tán. In 子弹 (bullet) the same character is read dàn.

examples.zh: 她会弹钢琴。
examples.en: She can play the piano.

examples.zh: 老师在弹钢琴，孩子们在唱歌。
examples.en: The teacher is playing the piano while the kids sing.

examples.zh: 你能给我们弹一首歌吗？
examples.en: Could you play a song for us?

meaning: person of note; character (in a story or film)

senses.en: person of note; character (in a story or film)

examples.zh: 他是我们公司的重要人物。
examples.en: He is an important figure in our company.

examples.zh: 这本小说里的人物很有意思。
examples.en: The characters in this novel are interesting.

examples.zh: 你最喜欢电影里的哪个人物？
examples.en: Which character in the movie do you like best?

note: Casual praise among friends. Another entry covers the animal.

examples.zh: 你一次就通过了？真牛！
examples.en: You passed on the first try? Awesome!

examples.zh: 他年纪小，但是很牛。
examples.en: He is young but really impressive.

examples.zh: 她拿了三个冠军，太牛了！
examples.en: She won three championships. Amazing!

examples.zh: 今天是我生日，我买了一个蛋糕。
examples.en: Today is my birthday, so I bought a cake.

examples.zh: 你要吃一块蛋糕吗？
examples.en: Would you like a piece of cake?

examples.zh: 这个蛋糕不太甜，我很喜欢。
examples.en: This cake isn't too sweet; I like it a lot.

meaning: to tidy up; to pack; to put in order

senses.en: to tidy up; to pack; to put in order

examples.zh: 客人马上来了，快把房间收拾一下。
examples.en: Guests are coming soon; quickly tidy up the room.

examples.zh: 我明天去旅行，今天要收拾行李。
examples.en: I'm traveling tomorrow, so I need to pack today.

examples.zh: 饭后，他收拾桌子，我洗碗。
examples.en: After the meal, he clears the table and I wash the dishes.
